cycle.name: New 6-week cycle
focus: Cluster back squats (intra-set rest to preserve bar speed)

crossfit.name: CrossFit
crossfit.note: Week 1 of 6. Squat stronger, move the bar faster, build pulling skills, work at a few different speeds.

mon.title: Power snatch + 4 × 2:30 AMRAP

sections.label: Strength
lines: A1. Power Snatch — 4 sets of 2, building
A2. Feet-Elevated Parallette Push Up — 4 sets of 8–12

sections.label: Conditioning
lines: Handstand Push Ups with remaining time

mon.coach_notes: Snatches: fast, not just heavy — crisp extension, decisive pull under, catch high. In the AMRAP the HSPU are the score; keep double unders ~30s, keep DB snatches moving, arrive at the wall with shoulders left. Aim for repeatable output across all four rounds.

tue.title: Cluster back squat + 8-min AMRAP

sections.label: Strength
lines: A. Cluster Back Squat — 5 sets of 2-2-1, building
B. Pendlay Row — 4 sets of 6–8, building

tue.coach_notes: 2-2-1 = five reps per set with short intra-set breaks to reset and brace. Eight minutes: too long to sprint, too short to settle. Fittest athletes can chase 10 rounds; pick variations that keep you moving.

wed.title: 4 × 10:00 HYROX-style pieces
wed.coach_notes: Each piece: buy-in, more buy-in, then use whatever time remains for max distance/calories. Decide how much to spend on the buy-in to earn the max window. 2:00 rest between parts — recover aggressively.

thu.title: RDL + pull skill, then row + 100 RKBS

sections.label: Strength
lines: A1. Romanian Deadlift — 4 sets of 6–8, building
A2. Pull-up / C2B / Bar Muscle-Up Practice — 4 sets

thu.coach_notes: Skill sets: work wherever you currently live on the pull-up → C2B → bar muscle-up spectrum; quality reps. Then settle into a strong row, relax the grip, and plan the swing sets before your forearms decide for you.

fri.title: Tempo cyclist squat + strict press, E2M × 9

sections.label: Strength
lines: A1. Goblet Cyclist Squat — 3 sets of 10–12 @ 31X1 tempo
A2. Strict Press — 3 sets of 8–10, building

fri.coach_notes: 31X1 = 3s down, 1s pause at bottom, stand with intent, reset at top. Rest is whatever you earn — efficient rounds give close to 1:1 work:rest. First three rounds unbroken and controlled; stay tidy as the bar gets heavier.

sat.title: Run → work → run → work → run (hybrid, for time)

sections.label: Conditioning
lines: then 2 rounds: 25m Sled Push (5/3, 7/5 plates) · 25 Burpees · 25 Tuck Ups · 250m Ski
then 2 rounds: 25 KB Deadlifts (2×24/16 kg, 2×32/24 kg) · 25 Sandbag Reverse Lunges (20/10, 30/20 kg) · 25 AbMat Sit-ups · 250m Row

sat.coach_notes: Four miles of prescribed running. Gear-shifting practice: leave each station and start running at a controlled pace before you feel recovered. Respect the opening run — start boring, stay consistent, get dangerous later.

athx.name: ATHX
athx.note: Test week — race-prep programming begins. Workouts mimic competition movements scaled to the 75-min (Tue) and 90-min (Sat) windows. ATHX Miami 10/10/26, Houston 10/17/26.

tue.title: ATHX 75 — test week

sections.label: ATHX MetCon / Endurance
lines: Station 5: 16 Plate-Elevated Dual DB Reverse Lunges (35/20) [Pro 50/25]

tue.coach_notes: Specificity block: race-specific movements, transitions, pacing, compromised running, and holding output after fatigue.

sat.title: ATHX 90 — test week

sections.label: ATHX Flow (Recovery)
lines: 1:00 Dynamic Yogi Squat with Hip Raises

sat.coach_notes: Same strength tests as Tuesday, then run/row endurance and a race-station MetCon.

sections.label: Main Lift
lines: Deadlift — build to a heavy 5; back off to 80% for 2 sets × 5
